# DC Career Lines

> Map your data center career: six training tracks from entry-level technician safety courses to engineering and management, with courses you can enroll in today.

DC Career Lines (https://dc-careers.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Data Center Electrical Safety, Raised Floor & Confined Space, Ergonomics & Manual Handling, Physical Security & Access or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://dc-careers.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Data Center Electrical Safety Training](https://dc-careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-electrical-safety): $99.99 per seat, 2 Hours. Foundational electrical safety practices for anyone working around data center power systems. Enroll: https://dc-careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-electrical-safety?buy=852
- [Data Center Raised Floor and Confined Space Awareness Training](https://dc-careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-raised-floor-confined-space): $99.99 per seat, 1 Hour, OSHA 1910.146. Confined space awareness and safe practices for working under a raised floor. Enroll: https://dc-careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-raised-floor-confined-space?buy=856
- [Server Room Ergonomics and Manual Handling Training](https://dc-careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/server-room-ergonomics-manual-handling): $99.99 per seat, 1 Hour. Safe lifting and ergonomic practices for server room and data hall work. Enroll: https://dc-careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/server-room-ergonomics-manual-handling?buy=858
- [Data Center Physical Security and Access Control Training](https://dc-careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-physical-security-access-control): $99.99 per seat, 1 Hour. Foundational physical security and access control practices for data hall environments. Enroll: https://dc-careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-physical-security-access-control?buy=855
- [Data Center Operations Management](https://dc-careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-operations-management): $325.99 per seat, 8 Hours, DCIM / SLA Frameworks. Run daily operations like the teams behind Tier 3/4 facilities — maintenance, incident response, and SLAs. Enroll: https://dc-careers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-operations-management?buy=843
